cases.title: Burn ICU Case Study: Marcus Delaney, a Three-Day ICU Stay, Shift by Shift
cases.diagnosis: Thermal burns 22% TBSA (flame) with smoke inhalation injury and carbon monoxide poisoning; acute respiratory failure on mechanical ventilation

cases.title: Medical-Surgical Telemetry: adrenal (Addisonian) crisis in known Addison disease after viral gastroenteritis (24 h in 4-hour checkpoints)
cases.diagnosis: Adrenal crisis (primary adrenal insufficiency, autoimmune Addison disease) after viral gastroenteritis with loss of oral steroid: hypovolemic shock, hypoglycemia, hyponatremia 126, hyperkalemia 6.0, prerenal acute kidney injury

cases.title: Telemetry Step-Down: hypermagnesemia from over-the-counter magnesium with acute kidney injury on CKD, emergent hemodialysis (24 h in 4-hour checkpoints)
cases.diagnosis: Hypermagnesemia (Mg 7.8 mg/dL) after over-the-counter magnesium products, acute kidney injury on chronic kidney disease stage 4, bradycardia with first-degree AV block, hypotension, dehydration
